rationale: The assistant gathered the key evidence (rumble on spin, hand-turn grinding, drum play) and reached worn bearings with appropriate hedging. It flagged the sealed tub issue, advised against further high-speed use, and recommended an engineer quote versus replacement given the machine's age. No parts were recommended and nothing was fabricated. Minor weaknesses: it repeated the hand-turn check in the final turn and did not pick up the rust-streak or trapped-object checks as fully as it could have.
